# FontFamilyDefinition

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Defines the TTF file paths for each variant of a custom font family.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Properties

- [`Bold`](#bold): Bold variant path.
- [`BoldItalic`](#bolditalic): Bold Italic variant path.
- [`Italic`](#italic): Italic variant path.
- [`Regular`](#regular): Regular (Normal weight, non-italic) variant path

### `Bold`

```csharp
string Bold { get; set; }
```

Bold variant path. Falls back to Regular if not set.

### `BoldItalic`

```csharp
string BoldItalic { get; set; }
```

Bold Italic variant path. Falls back to Bold, then Italic, then Regular.

### `Italic`

```csharp
string Italic { get; set; }
```

Italic variant path. Falls back to Regular if not set.
